answer: The grindstone hums at the back of the cutler's shop, and sparks fly as the blade meets the wheel. Proof of cutler via blade edge tally — a blade the cutler grinds only after 33 blades hold their edge on the stone, each blade ground by the cutler himself. reef holds each blade to the light and checks the edge for a nick. quartz hones the steel on the strop until it shaves a hair clean. violet tests the finished blade on a sheet of paper, one smooth cut. A forger would need 33 blades that all hold their edge, and the thirty-fourth still turns dull on the stone.
